tags: position, unrealised pnl, live mark, tick flash, count-up, card

name: P&L Bridge Waterfall
tags: waterfall, bridge, attribution, contribution, stagger, pnl
note: Waterfall bridging each position contribution into today net P&L, with dashed connectors and a separated net column. Every column carries three custom properties (--t25-b start, --t25-h height, --t25-l connector level) so rescaling is a markup edit, not a JS change. Columns are real buttons: hover or tab dims the rest and prints the exact figure in the header, click replays the staggered rise.
html: P&L bridge · today Net ▲ +$1,610

name: Realised vs Unrealised Ring
tags: donut, ring, realised, unrealised, split, svg, count-up
note: Two-arc SVG ring splitting book P&L into realised and unrealised, with a counting net figure in the core. The arcs draw in by transitioning stroke-dasharray from zero; the legend rows are buttons that spotlight their arc on hover, focus or click. Share is measured on absolute size so a losing leg still reads correctly, and every row pairs colour with an arrow and a sign.

name: Exposure by Asset Class
tags: exposure, asset class, stacked bar, gross, leverage, stagger
note: Gross exposure as a 100% stacked bar over per-class rows whose fills grow in on a stagger (keyframes animate to each row --t25-w). Rows are buttons, so hover, tap or tab links a row to its stack segment in both directions and prints that class share in the header. Long and short are marked with an arrow plus colour, never colour alone.
html: Gross exposure $412.4k 1.72×

name: Margin Utilisation Meter
tags: gauge, margin, utilisation, needle, spring, svg, risk
note: Semicircular SVG gauge for margin utilisation: the arc grows by transitioning stroke-dasharray while an HTML needle springs on an overshoot curve (an HTML needle avoids the transform-box pitfalls of rotating SVG groups). Ticks mark the 60% warning and the 85% maintenance call, and the arc, figure and status word switch together at those thresholds. The scenario button cycles four books so the amber and red states can be seen; the level is stated in words as well as colour.

name: Position Size Calculator
tags: calculator, risk, sizing, inputs, slider, validation
note: Risk-first sizing: type an entry and stop, drag the risk slider, and shares, notional and money-at-risk recompute on every keystroke with a short bump on the figure that changed. The slider track fill is a gradient driven by one custom property. An invalid stop (at or above entry) flips the header to a red inline warning, outlines the stop field and blanks the outputs rather than printing a nonsense size.

name: Break-even Indicator
tags: break-even, price rail, marker, loss zone, live mark, fees
note: Price rail showing entry, the fee-adjusted break-even and the live mark. Loss and profit zones split at break-even, the dashed break-even line breathes, and the mark marker slides on a spring as the price walks every 2.2s. If the mark crosses below break-even the marker, arrow, status and distance flip together. Rail geometry comes from three custom properties on the root, so a new price range is a one-line change.
